question: How much did inKind raise in its latest financing tranche?

hits.title: Liberty Mutual Investments provides $320 million financing to support inKind's restaurant expansion.
hits.snippet: [receives_financing | 2026-07-01 | $320 million] InKind received financing of $320M in financing on Jul 1st '26. Liberty Mutual Investments (LMI) has committed more than $320 million in financing to restaurant technology company inKind, providing growth capital that will help expand the platform's network of restaurant partners and accelerate the development of new AI-powered tools for operators.
hits.summary: InKind received financing of $320M in financing on Jul 1st '26.

hits.snippet: [receives_financing | $450M] inKind receives financing of $450M in funding. inKind, an Austin, TX-based provider of a restaurant commerce enablement platform, raised $450M in funding.
